import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
X = rng.normal(size=(5, 3))
W1 = rng.normal(size=(3, 4))
W2 = rng.normal(size=(4, 2))


two_layers=(X@W1)@W2
W=W1@W2
same=np.allclose(X@W,two_layers)
with_relu_same=np.allclose(np.maximum(0,X@W1)@W2,X@W)
